_comment: thicket_keeps_talk's start: warrior5+mage5 standing at riverfarm_village (12,10) facing right, directly west of riverfarm_hunter (13,10) -- first interact plays his talk_pool line, the second opens riverfarm_hunter. heard_thicket_keeps is NOT banked. NO detect_magic anywhere in this save: that is load-bearing, because this canonical owns hut_ward_scrap's locked_toast negative (interactions.gd:150-157 only emits skill_hint_toast when the required skill is already known). Built from riverfarm_fight_start (the region's shipped baseline: post-mounting, door_awakened + riverfarm_attuned, so riverfarm_village/riverfarm_mill/witch_hollow/witch_hut all satisfy test_fixture_coherence MAP_REQUIRES). Adds blight_lifted + heard_price_of_a_favor + price_of_a_favor_reported: both v0.16 side quests hang their start option off price_of_a_favor_reported, so a save that has not closed 'The Price of a Favor' cannot see them. TRAP: rng_state is DERIVED (tests/_derive_rng_state.gd), never hand-typed; WISave restores .state directly and RNG_STATE_MIN_MAGNITUDE rejects small ints.
